text.arabic_uthmani: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا

baseline.text: Sana Zülkarneyn hakkında soruyorlar. De ki: Size ondan bir bölüm anlatacağım.

findings.text: Verilecek cevap eksiksiz bir yaşam öyküsü değil, daha büyük ve bilinmeyen hayattan eyleme yön veren ilişkileri seçen bir hatırlatmadır.
İki boynuzlu unvanı, doğu ile batı ve ceza ile iyilik gibi karşıt yönleri tek bir yönetim yöntemi altında eşleyen bir başlık işlevi görür.

activation_trace.role: Request and inquiry supply the initiating demand.
Uttered speech turns the response into an explicit verbal act.
Following and succession give the promised delivery an ordered motion.
A reminder supplies the selected mnemonic outcome of that motion.

changed_reading.after: A promise to answer demand with an ordered, selected remembrance that follows out in speech.
changed_reading.before: A promise to tell information about a named figure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from the plural asking through قُلْ and سَأَتْلُوا to ذِكْرًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A demand initiates commanded speech whose content follows in sequence and lands as a reminder; مِنْهُ makes that reminder a selected trace rather than an exhaustive life.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another makes the title a relation between two parts.
A projecting horn or extremity gives the joined parts a two-ended spatial form.

changed_reading.after: The epithet also primes an identity organized by linked extremities or paired poles.
changed_reading.before: Dhu al-Qarnayn functions only as a conventional epithet.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual form in ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title can hold one identity together through two linked, projecting ends. Before any context is read, it therefore opens a paired-span model alongside the ordinary proper-name reading.

activation_trace.role: Inquiry supplies the social demand around the remembered figure.
Speech circulating among people supplies the public-discourse field being redirected.
Reputation and renown make the subject a bearer of social memory.
Reminder recasts that reputation as an intentionally bounded recollection.

changed_reading.after: The response intervenes in public memory by reshaping circulating fame into a controlled reminder.
changed_reading.before: The audience requests a biography and receives one.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A plural audience asks, and the response is commanded as a spoken ذِكْر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Public inquiry brings a figure already carried by reputation into speech; the commanded answer converts circulating talk into a bounded reminder rather than simply adding another report.

activation_trace.role: Ordered following supplies the motion of the promised recital.
Following behind directly mirrors the focus verb's sequential motion in the protagonist's travel.
A rope-like connection makes each followed unit a link in the route and in the telling.
Tracing step after step sharpens the recital as a tracked itinerary rather than a loose anecdote.

changed_reading.after: The delivery itself retraces the hero's linked itinerary, making narrative sequence enact traveled sequence.
changed_reading.before: The speaker will deliver an ordered remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hero repeatedly follows a link or means, while the speaker promises to make the account follow in recitation. Narrative order thus retraces the subject's linked travel: verbal following mirrors spatial following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies follow imagery for both تلو and تبع and a linking image for سبب; I supply the arrow that the telling formally imitates the travel. A live alternative is that the repetition only advances the plot.
structural_cues: The formula of following a sabab recurs at 18:85, 18:89, and 18:92.
The focus promise precedes and contains the three route segments.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following prior material lets the recital register as a carried residue rather than the whole.
Reminder defines the selected unit preserved for the audience.
Wholeness and encompassing totality provide the maximal scope against which the focus excerpt is measured.
Complete cognitive encompassing locates total knowledge outside the limited recital.
Knowledge of inward circumstance specifies the depth available but not exhaustively narrated.

changed_reading.after: Its selectivity is principled: a human-facing reminder remains partial even under a horizon of comprehensive provision and knowledge.
changed_reading.before: The account is short because only some information is being offered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers only a remembrance from him, while the context names provision from every thing and complete encompassing knowledge of his circumstances. The recital's partiality becomes epistemic discipline: selection is maintained in the presence of totalizing capacity and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit partitive and totalizing constructions; I infer a deliberate scope contrast that marks restraint in narration. The alternative is that the totalizing phrases serve only their local clauses.
structural_cues: The partitive مِنْهُ in 18:83 contrasts with مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ in 18:84.
The divine first-person plural in 18:91 claims encompassing knowledge while the commissioned speaker promises only a selected reminder.

activation_trace.role: Joining two things supplies the title's unifying relation.
Projecting extremities supply the two-ended geometry activated by the itinerary.
Sunset and west establish one explicit horizon pole.
The luminary's rising and its place establish the opposed horizon pole.
The middle between two things shifts the paired geometry from extremities to a junction.
Closing a gap between two things turns the junction into an engineering task.
Raised mountain sides give the two joined limits concrete projecting faces.

changed_reading.after: The title organizes the account's movement from paired horizons to the constructive joining of paired mountain limits.
changed_reading.before: The title hints generally at two linked extremities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The itinerary reaches setting and rising poles, then moves to the middle between two barriers and fills the gap between mountain sides. The dual title becomes a spatial grammar: paired extremities are traversed and then joined.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed solar limits followed by a between-two construction; I infer that this sequence activates the dual title as a compositional key. The title may instead remain conventional, and the solar language may mark viewpoint rather than mapped world-edges.
structural_cues: 18:86 and 18:90 use parallel reach-sun-find sequences at setting and rising.
The third journey changes from reaching an outer pole to reaching between a dual barrier and equalizing between dual sides.

activation_trace.role: A matched counterpart supplies the focus anchor for paired adjudicative outcomes.
Punitive pain supplies one offered and later conditioned response.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the offered counterpart to punishment.
Withholding what is right gives the negative condition a functional wrong.
Recompense matching an act supplies the balancing rule for the positive condition.

changed_reading.after: It can also frame rule as the capacity to hold opposed conducts together under paired, fitted responses.
changed_reading.before: The title's duality is physical or geographic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offered alternatives of punishment or goodness become matched conditional responses: withheld right is answered by punishment and return, while faithful action is answered by fitting recompense and ease. The title's counterpart branch therefore supports an ethical, not only spatial, duality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired alternatives, paired conditions, and matching consequence imagery; I map that architecture back to the title's counterpart branch. The live alternative is that the title contributes nothing to the legal contrast.
structural_cues: The إِمَّا ... وَإِمَّا alternatives in 18:86 are answered by the أَمَّا ... وَأَمَّا conditions across 18:87-88.
The two branches are not symmetrical in content, but each links conduct to a fitted consequence.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation over an affair lets the focus command open a mediated exchange, not a monologue only.
Understanding marks the communicative threshold the encounter nearly fails to cross.
The people's proposal supplies negotiated speech about a concrete common problem.
Mutual assistance converts the exchanged words into shared labor.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope gives collective labor its operative force.
Repeated uttered commands coordinate the successive construction operations.

changed_reading.after: It also previews speech as mediation that can translate a collective question into organized, shared action.
changed_reading.before: The focus response reshapes public memory through speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near-failure of understanding does not end communication: speech becomes negotiation, then imperatives recruit help and combine strength for construction. The focus command to say and promise to recite can therefore model mediated authority that turns an audience's need into coordinated action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communicative difficulty, proposal and counterproposal, help, combined strength, and commands; I infer an arrow from intelligible speech to coordinated capacity. The alternative is that these are local dialogue and labor details without a reflexive link to the focus recital.
structural_cues: A people who scarcely understand speech at 18:93 nevertheless formulate a proposal at 18:94 and receive a counterproposal at 18:95.
The imperatives across 18:95-96 recruit the addressees into staged work.

remaining_uncertainties: The paired spatial and judicial structures may be compositional effects without intentional activation of the title's branch images.
The contrast between comprehensive knowledge and partial recital may be local rhetoric rather than a deliberate epistemic rule.
The extraction and iron-record outliers depend on form-distant or cross-domain branches and require explicit qualification.
strongest_changes: The repeated following of a sabab makes the promised recital formally retrace the protagonist's route.
Total provision and encompassing knowledge sharpen مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا into a disciplined partial trace.
West, east, and the junction between two barriers activate the dual title as the account's spatial architecture.
Paired alternatives and consequences extend the title's duality into adjudication.
Communicative difficulty followed by negotiated, collective work revises speech from report into coordination.
summary.what_was_special: Context did not settle one identity for the title; it activated several anchored functions at once: linked itinerary, paired geography, paired judgment, bounded memory, and executable speech. Split-root and material-text branches preserved two stranger readings without promoting them to lexical claims.

activation_trace.role: Gentle drawing-out supplies the image of extracting one strand from a larger body.
A remainder following what precedes gives the extracted strand a partial and sequential form.
Reminder makes the extracted strand a mnemonic sample rather than discarded residue.

changed_reading.after: The question may be heard as drawing out one carefully selected mnemonic strand from a larger, partly withheld account.
changed_reading.before: The question merely requests available information.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from س ء ل to س ل ل rather than ordinary morphology. The supplied mapping, the focus partitive, and the reminder anchor keep an extraction image live, but downstream prose should present it only as a branch echo, never as the lexical meaning of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The asking verb together with مِنْهُ and the promised reminder.

activation_trace.role: A document securing a right gives the reminder a record-bearing edge.
Assembled masses supply the literal modular units of the barrier.
Writing and book imagery lets those modular units carry a qualified inscription analogy.
A distinguishing boundary defines what the material record temporarily enforces.
A promise fixed to a coming time gives the barrier an explicit expiry horizon.
Demolition to level ground makes the physical boundary temporary and the narrated record comparatively durable.

changed_reading.after: The reminder may function as a verbal deed-record that preserves the purpose and expiry of a material boundary after that boundary is flattened.
changed_reading.before: The reminder briefly reports the making of a wall.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading uses neighboring block and writing branches under ز ب ر and the documentary branch of ذ ك ر. It remains anchored in the focus reminder and the packet's material sequence, but it should be rendered as a possible material-textual analogy, not as a claim that the iron blocks literally mean writing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The object ذِكْرًا as a potentially record-bearing reminder.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The answer is a selective reminder, not exhaustive biography.** `ذ ك ر` B009 (“reminder or admonition”) is what will be recited from him. The cave account similarly disciplines curiosity about number (18:22), and divine words exceed any oceanic record (18:109). I infer that narration selects action-guiding relations from a larger unknown life. The question receives morally functional recollection rather than total information.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:109 confirmed that every narrated reminder is necessarily selective against inexhaustible divine words.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A paired title organizing opposed policy branches.** `ق ر ن/B006` supplies strong horn-like projections and includes the title form, while `ق ر ن/B001` is joining one thing to another. The announced account grants broad enablement (18:84), follows a means (18:85), and at the sunset encounter presents two alternatives whose punitive and beneficent branches are realized in 18:86–88. I infer that the paired projection image organizes the capacity to hold divergent responses inside one governed itinerary. `ذِي ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ` reads functionally as a role joining opposed policy branches, without requiring a biographical identification.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:84–86 activated the title through enablement, a followed connection, and arrival at one extreme; the title began functioning as itinerary rather than ornament.

words.gloss_range: light resumptive connector opening a new question frame while keeping continuity with the surah's inquiry pattern
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) reopens the discourse after the completed explanation in 18:82 without making the new question syntactically part of that prior speech. Its light connection lets the Dhū al-Qarnayn unit start fresh while still sounding joined to the surah's sequence of disclosed explanations. Because the connector is fused to {{ar:يَسْأَلُونَكَ}} ({{tr:yasʾalūnaka}}), the ayah begins not with a bare topic label but with an already moving report of inquiry. The familiar {{ar:وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ}} ({{tr:wa-yasʾalūnaka}}) question-answer opener recalls legal-question formulas (2:189, 2:215, 2:217, 2:219, 2:222), but here that frame is redirected into narrative.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following asking verb to which the connector is attached
the fused connector-plus-question opener

topics.headline: resumptive opening seals and reopens discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the new story starts with continuity but not direct syntactic continuation from 18:82.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as conjunction or discourse resumption, and the attachment evidence starts a new question clause at 18:83:1-5; the CRITICAL boundary rows therefore survive as discourse framing.

topics.headline: connector arrives already attached to inquiry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pericope begins as reported questioning, and that a familiar ruling-question formula (2:189, 2:215, 2:217, 2:219, 2:222) is locally turned toward narrative.
topics.reason: The connector is a proclitic before the asking verb, and the supplied formula rows give concrete question-formula parallels (2:189, 2:215, 2:217, 2:219, 2:222); no guardrail evidence blocks the narrative specialization.

words.gloss_range: they ask you; locally an imperfect report of inquiry with the Prophet as questioned addressee and the topic marked by following {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}})
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْأَلُونَكَ}} ({{tr:yasʾalūnaka}}) compresses two parties into one verb: the unnamed plural askers are carried by the imperfect ending, while {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:-ka}}) makes the Prophet the queried addressee. The following {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) keeps Dhū al-Qarnayn as the topic asked about, not the direct object demanded. The imperfect form makes the inquiry ongoing or characteristic, and the Form I surface reports their asking rather than commanding them to ask or making the root itself provide the answer. The root's petitionary edge remains useful because the questioners depend on an authoritative response, but the fulfillment is displaced into {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) and {{ar:سَأَتْلُو}} ({{tr:saʾatlū}}). The medial hamza puts a brief catch inside the asking verb itself, so the word of inquiry audibly hinges before it moves on to the addressed Prophet. The same surah has already made asking and remembrance a charged pair in 18:70, and here the public question is answered by a promised {{ar:ذِكْرًا}} ({{tr:dhikran}}).
words.root_gloss_range: asking, requesting, seeking, demanding, or petitioning; local grammar selects inquiry-about while preserving dependence on an answer

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the attached second-person object suffix inside the asking verb
the following preposition that marks the topic of inquiry
the command that turns inquiry into response
the promised recitation that supplies the answer
the remembrance object promised as the answer

topics.headline: asked person and asked-about topic stay separate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is the queried addressee while Dhū al-Qarnayn remains the mediated topic of inquiry.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:-ka}}) as the direct object of asking and {{ar:عَنْ ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ}} ({{tr:ʿan dhī al-qarnayni}}) as the governed topic complement.

topics.headline: imperfect report keeps inquiry active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the question as an active reported pressure rather than a single completed event or an imperative directed at the questioners.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the surface as imperfect indicative 3mp plus 2ms object suffix, supporting the CRITICAL rows about ongoing reported inquiry.

topics.headline: asking keeps dependence but not demand-object grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the asking is not neutral curiosity only; it places the questioners in need of an answer while grammar narrows the local sense to inquiry-about.
topics.reason: The broad root range includes request and petition, but the local {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) construction selects asking about a topic rather than demanding a direct object.

topics.headline: legal-question formula (2:189, 2:215, 2:217, 2:219, 2:222) becomes narrative answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar question-response formula (2:189, 2:215, 2:217, 2:219, 2:222) and the 18:70 ask-until-remembrance pattern are redirected into this narrative disclosure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallels for the formula (2:189, 2:215, 2:217, 2:219, 2:222) and same-surah echoes, including 18:70, so the connection can survive without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: hamza makes inquiry audibly hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small acoustic stop inside the asking verb that matches the word's role as a hinge into the answer.
topics.reason: The prosodic row describes the audible surface and does not contradict the grammar; it remains a minor reader-facing payoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the topic of inquiry while preserving mediated distance from the absent figure
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) is the hinge that prevents the asking verb from collapsing into a demand frame. It governs {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) in the following title phrase, making Dhū al-Qarnayn the topic about which they ask rather than the thing directly requested. The preposition also keeps the figure at a distance: he is not present as an interlocutor or object in the scene, but becomes accessible through a mediated question and the coming recitation. Because {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) stands independently before its complement, the aboutness relation is visible before the title is completed.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed title head following the preposition

topics.headline: preposition turns the title into a governed topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah asks about Dhū al-Qarnayn through a prepositional topic frame, not by making him a direct object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:عَنْ ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ}} ({{tr:ʿan dhī al-qarnayni}}) as the topic complement of {{ar:يَسْأَلُونَكَ}} ({{tr:yasʾalūnaka}}).

topics.headline: aboutness keeps the figure absent and mediated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition both names the topic and keeps the named figure removed from direct presence.
topics.reason: The semantic range of {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) supports topic marking and separation, and local syntax licenses both as reader-facing nuance.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct possessor or attribute-bearer, binding the title to the following definite dual complement
words.prose: {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) sits between two dependencies: it is governed by {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) and it governs {{ar:ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-qarnayni}}) as its construct complement. That makes the whole title a governed topic phrase, not a new subject clause. The word's construct state gives the figure name-like identifiability through the definite dual attribute rather than through an independent personal name. Its dh-w-w force is characterizing: the person is introduced as the bearer of the two-qarn attribute before any action is narrated. The initial dh sound also returns in the final {{ar:ذِكْرًا}} ({{tr:dhikran}}), linking the title-bearing subject to the remembrance that will transmit him while keeping the two roots and functions distinct. The same title later shifts case and address as a direct vocative at 18:86 and 18:94, so this first genitive form opens a title that the story will reuse in direct encounter.
words.root_gloss_range: possessor, owner, one characterized by, with related essence and construct-title uses; local branch is attribute-bearing construct

words.gloss_range: second-person imperative say, pivoting the reported question into an authorized speech frame
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) is the ayah's pivot from third-person report to commanded response. Its compact imperative makes the same addressee who was questioned in {{ar:يَسْأَلُونَكَ}} ({{tr:yasʾalūnaka}}) become the instructed speaker. The word governs not a simple noun object but the following utterance-frame, {{ar:سَأَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا}} ({{tr:saʾatlū ʿalaykum minhu dhikran}}). Its hard qaf opening and quick lām-sukūn landing make the command sound like a clipped turn between the report and the reply. The Form I command keeps the Prophet as transmitter of authorized speech, not an anonymous passive report, private knowledge, or fabricated attribution. Its familiar Quranic command formula also normalizes the Dhū al-Qarnayn narrative as revelation-response speech, with a same-surah command counterpart at 18:103.
